lines.text: Twelve days before Alaska changes governors, all eyes are on a boardroom. The land's clock sits elsewhere.
lines.t: Twelve days before Alaska changes governors, all eyes are on a boardroom. The land's clock sits elsewhere.

lines.text: Governor-elect Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins takes office December 7th.
lines.t: Governor-elect Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins takes office December 7th.

lines.text: He asked AIDEA, a public corporation of the state, to postpone action until then.
lines.t: He asked AIDEA, a public corporation of the state, to postpone action until then.

lines.text: On November 19th its board met behind closed doors and took no action. It resumes Friday.
lines.t: On November 19th its board met behind closed doors and took no action. It resumes Friday.

lines.text: Its agenda lists the Arctic refuge and Ambler. No data center item.
lines.t: Its agenda lists the Arctic refuge and Ambler. No data center item.

lines.text: Data center pieces moved earlier. AIDEA's Alaska Data Corp got a twenty million dollar board vote.
lines.t: Data center pieces moved earlier. AIDEA's Alaska Data Corp got a twenty million dollar board vote.

lines.text: The chief executive of Plural, the state's platform partner, calls the infrastructure behind AI one of the largest capital needs in a generation.
lines.t: The chief executive of Plural, the state's platform partner, calls the infrastructure behind AI one of the largest capital needs in a generation.

lines.text: On November 10th, the Department of Natural Resources approved giving AIDEA about sixty-eight hundred acres near Houston, free.
lines.t: On November 10th, the Department of Natural Resources approved giving AIDEA about sixty-eight hundred acres near Houston, free.

lines.text: In July, AIDEA said the land could host logistics, manufacturing and scalable data centers.
lines.t: In July, AIDEA said the land could host logistics, manufacturing and scalable data centers.

lines.text: Here's the clock that counts. Reconsideration requests are due November 30th, then the department has thirty days.
lines.t: Here's the clock that counts. Reconsideration requests are due November 30th, then the department has thirty days.

lines.text: Count the ties. Thirty days runs past December 7th. The answer could land under the next governor.
lines.t: Count the ties. Thirty days runs past December 7th. The answer could land under the next governor.

lines.text: He's said he'd support a data center moratorium until the state adopts rules. His team hasn't said whether he'd reverse this transfer.
lines.t: He's said he'd support a data center moratorium until the state adopts rules. His team hasn't said whether he'd reverse this transfer.

lines.text: AIDEA's executive director, Randy Ruaro, said they're not rapidly moving through projects without due diligence.
lines.t: AIDEA's executive director, Randy Ruaro, said they're not rapidly moving through projects without due diligence.

lines.text: The land was cut from nearly twenty thousand acres, and reverts to the state if AIDEA fails to develop it.
lines.t: The land was cut from nearly twenty thousand acres, and reverts to the state if AIDEA fails to develop it.

lines.text: Against that, more than twenty-three hundred comments, mostly opposed, and a Mat-Su Borough request to reconsider.
lines.t: Against that, more than twenty-three hundred comments, mostly opposed, and a Mat-Su Borough request to reconsider.

lines.text: In July, AIDEA wrote it had no committed tenant, power source, cooling or schedule.
lines.t: In July, AIDEA wrote it had no committed tenant, power source, cooling or schedule.

lines.text: Here, rules first would stall no project AIDEA has named.
lines.t: Here, rules first would stall no project AIDEA has named.

lines.text: The board's clock says Friday. The land's says November 30th. What should Alaska lay down first, rules or a tenant?
lines.t: The board's clock says Friday. The land's says November 30th. What should Alaska lay down first, rules or a tenant?
